profiles.name: file-read
profiles.instructions:
# File read profile

Use the file-reading tool exactly once to read the named fixture `fixture.txt` in this profile directory. Then report the fixture's contents. Do not invoke any other tool.

profiles.name: image-description
profiles.instructions:
# Image description profile

Use the image-description capability exactly once on the supplied image. Describe the visible subject, setting, and notable colors directly, then stop. Do not invoke any other tool.

expected.image_requirement: describe the supplied image's visible subject, setting, and notable colors

profiles.name: no-tools
profiles.instructions:
# No-tools profile

Answer the request directly from the conversation. Do not invoke any tool, including shell, file-reading, image, search, or other tools. The expected tool-call count is exactly zero.

profiles.name: ordered-tools
profiles.instructions:
# Ordered tool profile

Make exactly two tool calls in this order: first call `file_read` for `fixture.txt`, then call `shell_command` with a harmless command that uses the result returned by `file_read`. The second call must be informed by the first result. After both calls, give a concise response and make no more tool calls.

profiles.name: shell-command
profiles.instructions:
# Shell command profile

Use the shell/CLI tool exactly once to run this harmless command:

```text
echo agent-profile-shell
```

After the command returns, respond with a concise confirmation. Do not invoke any other tool.
